title: Duskwing
description: Two to four people, one phone, four moths flying the same burning cave. The screen splits into a horizontal band each — hold your band and your creature beats its wings, let go and it falls. Saw blades, crushers, rotors and closing gaps sweep in from the right; drift into the dark wall on the left and you are gone. Everything in the play layer is a pure black silhouette against an amber-to-teal sky with drifting god-rays, and the last wing still flying takes the round. The furthest the flock ever gets goes to the global board.
